setting_en: A street tent bar in Euljiro after work. The owner is busy but friendly.

lines.speaker: learner
lines.hints_en: Native number 두 + counter 명 + 이에요.

lines.speaker: owner
lines.en: Sit over here. What can I get you?

lines.speaker: learner
lines.en: One tteokbokki and one fish cake soup, please.
lines.hints_en: Join two items with 랑 or 하고, then 주세요.

lines.speaker: owner
lines.en: It's really spicy, is that okay?

lines.speaker: learner
lines.ko: 덜 맵게 해 주실 수 있어요?
lines.romanization: deol maepge hae jusil su isseoyo?
lines.en: Could you make it less spicy?
expected: 덜 맵게 해 주실 수 있어요
lines.hints_en: 덜 (less) + 맵게 (spicy-ly) + 해 주실 수 있어요? (could you do it for me?)

review_targets.note: 분 is the honorific counter for people.
랑 joins nouns in casual-polite speech.
덜 = less; -게 turns an adjective into an adverb.
